author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Take more control over your meetings in Microsoft Teams! This video shows 20 features to help power users schedule and facilitate meetings more efficiently. Learn how to define roles, set up meetings to record automatically, and make other configurations when scheduling meetings. You will also see several tools to use during your meetings to manage polls, generate live captions, show PowerPoint presentations the right way, and more. 

What you’ll learn:
• Test your meeting setup and optimize virtual backgrounds
• Find the best time to schedule your meetings
• Set up meetings more efficiently by setting roles, controlling the lobby, or setting meetings to record automatically
• Share your screen or PowerPoint presentations effectively
• Enable/disable permissions for meeting attendees
• Run a poll during a meeting
• Use the Together mode, Gallery view, Speaker view, or hide your own video
• Enable live captions
• Get help from Copilot during or after a meeting
• Use the meeting facilit
title: Microsoft Teams: 20 Meeting Tips & Tricks
